name: Asterius
source:
You are the grandchild of Helios. God of the sun. It's only natural the divine blood in your veins should strengthen your powers over the long... long... long time you have been imprisoned in this Labyrinth.

Each new fool that enters is a new opportunity to free yourself from this place.

One way or another...

[From [url=https://teamsnowcone.itch.io/asterius]itch.io[/url]]
